description: The four steps to ship a new version: bump the version, rebuild, validate, and upload.

steps.description: These are the update steps. The page says that when you fix a bug or add a feature, you bump `version` in `pyproject.toml`, rebuild, and upload.
The comment reminds you to edit `pyproject.toml` and set a new version, here `0.1.1`.

`python3 -m build` rebuilds the distributions. `twine check dist/*` validates them. `twine upload dist/*` uploads them. The page says users get the update by running `pip install --upgrade mylang-cs374`.

title: Updating Your Package
